name: Duotone icon
region: Open icon systems with a duotone weight, such as Phosphor
summary: Icons in two tones of one colour: a main shape at full strength and a secondary layer at 20–40% opacity. The second tone gives hierarchy and a little depth, but the icon stays a flat glyph.

philosophy.core_thesis: One colour in two strengths gives an icon a figure and a ground, so the meaning reads first and the detail second.
design_principles: Split each icon into a primary layer and a secondary layer.
Set the primary layer at 100% opacity and the secondary layer at 20–40% opacity of the same colour.
Make the secondary layer the larger, simpler area: a body, a ground or a fill under the outline.
Use the 24 px grid with a 2 px stroke or a solid primary shape; keep the weight of the base set.
Keep the two layers aligned; the secondary layer never offsets from the primary.
Use one hue for both layers; a second hue only as a deliberate brand choice.
anti_patterns: Two unrelated hues in one icon
Secondary layer at more than 50% opacity
Secondary layer offset from the outline

grid.keylines: The keylines of the base set: a circle of 20 px and a square of 18 px.

stroke.rule: The primary layer keeps the 2 px stroke of the base set; the secondary layer is a fill with no stroke.

shape.primitives: The shapes of the base outline set; the secondary fill follows the closed shapes.
shape.optical_size: At 16 px, drop the secondary layer if it adds noise; at 32 px and above, keep both layers.

colour.strategy: One hue in two strengths: 100% for the figure, 20–40% for the secondary layer.

perspective_and_light.light: No light model; the light tone works as a soft fill, not as light.
perspective_and_light.shadow: No shadow; the two layers are flat.

metaphor.typical: A house, an envelope, a folder, a chart and a shield.
metaphor.treatment: The outline of the object plus a soft fill in the main body.

emotion.target_response: Friendly order: the icon feels soft and a little rich, and still calm.

avoid_when: The icon is a 12–16 px control in a dense UI.
The print process has one ink with no tint.

modifiers.how: Keep the 2 px stroke; remove the secondary layer.
Keep the two layers; give each its own flat hue at 100% and drop the stroke.
